## Purpose

Describe the reproduction, correction, analysis, or documentation change.

## Protocol impact

- [ ] No experimental-semantic change
- [ ] New protocol version or amendment
- [ ] Extension only

Explain any effect on comparability with existing runs.

## Evidence and validation

List tests, regeneration commands, issue references, and affected artifacts.

## Reporting checks

- [ ] Failed and null observations remain preserved.
- [ ] Generated data did not overwrite raw observations.
- [ ] External artifacts have immutable revisions and hashes.
- [ ] No credentials, private prompts, or unrelated service data are included.
